title: On Relationship Between Circuit Depth and Trainability of VQAs
summary: The training efficiency of Variational Quantum Algorithms (VQAs) is dictated by the geometry of their loss landscapes, which can be formally analysed by mapping these functions to random fields on manifolds. Instead of VQAs, we can then directly study the corresponding random fields, in our case, the Wishart Hypertoroidal Random Fields (WHRFs). We are mostly interested in the distribution of critical points (especially local minima) of WHRFs. For this purpose, the Kac-Rice formula is presented, reformulated, and simulated.
